name: Reality Needles
body:
School evocation; Level occultist 1, psychic 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1, Specialty School (Void)

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one creature
Duration Instantaneous (see text)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You pull fine shards and needles of varying materials from other planes and realities and shoot them at your target. The target takes 1d4 piercing damage and takes 1 bleed damage for 3 rounds.
